file_provider.name: LockedFileFinalHoldoutProviderV1
file_provider.constructor: pub fn open(file: std::fs::File, expected: &ProductFrozenEvaluationPlanV1) -> Result<Self, FileFinalHoldoutErrorV1>
file_provider.data_encoder: pub fn encode_file_final_holdout_material_v1(objective_digest: Digest32, dataset_digest: Digest32, final_holdout_window_id: &StableId, inputs: &TemporalComparisonInputsV1) -> Result<Vec<u8>, FileFinalHoldoutErrorV1>
file_provider.file_format: Versioned bounded binary data only: objective/dataset/window, complete training samples, held-out targets, candidate/baseline OPE observations, cluster assignments, snapshot/future-window IDs. Exact canonical bytes hash equals frozen final_holdout_digest. Header excludes the whole frozen plan digest to avoid circular hashing.
file_provider.held_custody: Takes an already authorized regular File and keeps its OS lock/owned open description; exposes no File clone/getter. Caller must not retain writable duplicates and remains responsible for trusted pathname/owner/permissions/containing-directory custody. No chmod, key creation, path reopening or authority inferred from digests.
file_provider.validation: Validate actual sealed product plan, bounded file size, exact digest and stable read; no decoded row release at open or manifest lookup. Re-read bounded exact content under the held file immediately during the one-shot permitted release; decode all fields without ignoring trailing bytes; require objective/dataset/window match exact frozen plan. Original runner still checks outcomes/cohorts/support/leakage/statistics.
file_provider.once_only: A release attempt consumes local release state before I/O. The original durable CAS prevents a new permit after consumption across original runner recovery. Wrong permit, file mutation, decode error or uncertain response never rearms the instance.
file_provider.external_inputs: Real independently collected data and provenance, actual immutable file, intended whole-content digest chosen in the original frozen plan, actual host namespace/permissions. The encoder does not manufacture these data or authenticate observer independence.

evidence_sink.durable_primitive: Wrap the existing concrete LockedFileProductEvaluationExecutionStoreV1 in a distinct qualification-evidence domain-bound namespace. Do not accept arbitrary store callbacks or pre-populated qualification structs. A physically distinct authorized File is supplied; derive internal binding with a fixed evidence-domain prefix from owner_binding.
evidence_sink.data_commitment: Encode complete actual execution digest + decision evaluation/candidate/baseline IDs + disposition + ordered failed_metrics + evidence_digest + trust_digest + authentication_digest, require DENY_ALL/nonzero commitments, and commit those exact bytes. The content digest is returned only after original durable claim/complete and exact committed readback.
evidence_sink.replay: Existing Completed with identical bytes yields the same publication digest without another write; changed binding or decision refuses. Pending/uncertain/torn/corrupt/rollback never becomes a fresh claim, a default result or successful publication. Errors after a possibly effective claim/write remain terminal/indeterminate.
evidence_sink.actual_recovery: Use original locked-file full history replay and independently retained minimum anchor. The sink readback returns only an exact data-publication digest, not ProductQualificationReceiptV1 or new evaluator authority.
evidence_sink.qualification: Only the unchanged original runner verifies signed V2/V3 evidence and builds its private-seal qualification after sink success. This adapter never signs, selects, activates, changes cost gates or accepts a precomputed Evaluation as execution.
evidence_sink.external_inputs: Declared authorized evidence namespace/File and durable parent directory, real independent minimum anchor/retention policy, current signatures supplied to the original runner. Storage checksums do not authenticate a role.
